description: This file defines a final class `AudioInputDeviceObserver` responsible for observing and managing audio input devices on macOS using CoreAudio APIs. It includes methods for getting default input device info, listing alive input device UIDs, checking for usable default input devices, and managing observers for device changes.

classes.name: AudioInputDeviceObserver
classes.description: A class that observes audio input device changes on macOS, allowing start/stop listening and querying default/input devices.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceUID
methods.description: Retrieves the UID of the current default input device, if available.

methods.name: aliveInputDeviceUIDs
methods.description: Returns a set of UIDs corresponding to currently alive input audio devices.

methods.name: hasUsableDefaultInputDevice
methods.description: Checks if the default input device exists and is currently usable with input channels.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceSummary
methods.description: Provides a string summary of the default input device's name and UID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts observing for audio device changes and triggers a callback on change.
